notes.title: Paladin 1.1.3.0 Released
notes.content:
Bug fixes

* Intermittent crash bug on Endurance when using nuke
* Cities not damaged on Endurance when tutorial had not been completed

Gameplay changes

* Scoring tweaks to new game styles with respect to difficulty levels

notes.title: Paladin update published
notes.content:
Hi folks,

I’ve just published an update to Paladin. I’ve added 4 new game styles, a couple of extra ships and some new pesky aliens. Hope you enjoy it.

See you on the leaderboards!

Cheers,
Paul :-)
